definitions.explanation: A way of doing something, used almost only in the negative: there is no way, no means left. Literary in tone, but common in set phrases such as {為|な}す{術|すべ}がない.

examples.japanese: ⟦{助|たす}ける→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧{術|すべ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There was no way to help.

examples.japanese: ⟦{津波|つなみ}→津波：05064_tsunami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{迫|せま}る→迫る：03928_semaru⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧、⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{為|な}す→為す：03915_nasu⟧{術|すべ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{立|た}ち{尽|つ}くしていた→立ち尽くす：31668_tachitsukusu⟧。
examples.english: As the tsunami approached, people stood there helpless.

notes:
The same kanji read じゅつ means a technique or art (⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧, ⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧); read すべ it means only "a way to do something". すべ is often written in kana.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{為|な}す→為す：03915_nasu⟧{術|すべ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ / ⟦{為|な}す→為す：03915_nasu⟧{術|すべ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧: there is nothing one can do; helplessly
- verb (dictionary form) + {術|すべ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: there is no way to ~ (⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧{術|すべ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: there is no way of knowing)
- ⟦{生|い}きる→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧{術|すべ}: the means to survive

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧ / ⟦{手段|しゅだん}→手段：03219_shudan⟧: method, means; neutral everyday words that work in positive sentences too
- ⟦{仕方|しかた}→仕方：01603_shikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: it can't be helped; resignation rather than helplessness
